title: Hanuma conveys to Rama that Seetha expressed a grave doubt
introduction: Hanuma informs Rama how Seetha expressed her grave doubt as to how monkeys and bears can leap across a vast sea, as well as her appeal to Rama to destroy Ravana along with his entire army in Lanka and take her back to Ayodhya. Hanuma further informs Rama, how he resolved her doubt by explaining the prowess of the troops of monkeys and bears, commanded by Sugreeva as also how he brought solace and peace to her from her worries.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 68th and conclusive Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
अथ अहम् उत्तरम् देव्या पुनः उक्तः ससम्भ्रमम् |
तव स्नेहान् नर व्याघ्र सौहार्यात् अनुमान्य च
verses.iast:
atha aham uttaram devyā punaḥ uktaḥ sasambhramam |
tava snehān nara vyāghra sauhāryāt anumānya ca
verses.translation: "O excellent among men! Having shown respect for me out of her affection and good-heartedness for you, I, who was in a haste to go, was spoken to again by Seetha the princess about the further course of action."

glosses.meaning: who was in a haste (to go)

verses.devanagari:
एवम् बहु विधम् वाच्यो रामो दाशरथिः त्वया |
यथा माम् आप्नुयात् शीघ्रम् हत्वा रावणम् आहवे
verses.iast:
evam bahu vidham vācyo rāmo dāśarathiḥ tvayā |
yathā mām āpnuyāt śīghram hatvā rāvaṇam āhave
verses.translation: "Rama, the son of Dasaratha, is to be informed by you thus in several ways, for quickly killing Ravana in battle and also as to how he can get me back."

verses.devanagari:
यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वस एका अहम् अरिम् दम |
कस्मिंश्चित् सम्वृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि
verses.iast:
yadi vā manyase vīra vasa ekā aham arim dama |
kasmiṃścit samvṛte deśe viśrāntaḥ śvo gamiṣyasi
verses.translation: " 'O hero the annihilator of enemies! If you deem it fit, stay for a day in a secret place. You can go tomorrow after taking rest'."

verses.devanagari:
मम च अपि अल्प भाग्यायाः साम्निध्यात् तव वानर |
अस्य शोक विपाकस्य मुहूर्तम् स्यात् विमोक्षणम्
verses.iast:
mama ca api alpa bhāgyāyāḥ sāmnidhyāt tava vānara |
asya śoka vipākasya muhūrtam syāt vimokṣaṇam
verses.translation: "'O the valiant one! Because of your presence, the termination of my full-blown grief may continue for a while'."

glosses.meaning: O the valiant one! tava saamnidhyaat = because of your presence
the termination of my full-flown grief

verses.devanagari:
गते हि त्वयि विक्रान्ते पुनः आगमनाय वै |
प्राणानाम् अपि संदेहो मम स्यान् न अत्र संशयः
verses.iast:
gate hi tvayi vikrānte punaḥ āgamanāya vai |
prāṇānām api saṃdeho mama syān na atra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "'When you, the courageous one, have actually left to come back, there will be a danger even to my life. There is no doubt about this'."

verses.devanagari:
तव अदर्शनजः शोको भूयो माम् परितापयेत् |
दुह्खात् दुह्ख पराभूताम् दुर्गताम् दुह्ख भागिनीम्
verses.iast:
tava adarśanajaḥ śoko bhūyo mām paritāpayet |
duhkhāt duhkha parābhūtām durgatām duhkha bhāginīm
verses.translation: "'The sorrow born of your disappearance will further torment me, who is overtaken by one sorrow after another, miserable and doomed to grief as I am'."

verses.devanagari:
अयम् तु वीर संदेहः तिष्ठति इव मम अग्रतः |
सुमहान् त्वत् सहायेषु हरि ऋक्षेषु असंशयः
verses.iast:
ayam tu vīra saṃdehaḥ tiṣṭhati iva mama agrataḥ |
sumahān tvat sahāyeṣu hari ṛkṣeṣu asaṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "'O best among the monkeys! O valiant one! In the matter of monkeys and bears who are your helpmates, this very grave doubt stands before me'."

glosses.meaning: the valiant one! haryR^ikSeSu = in the matter of monkeys and bears

verses.devanagari:
कथम् नु खलु दुष्पारम् तरिष्यन्ति महाउदधिम् |
तानि हरि ऋक्ष सैन्यानि तौ वा नर वर आत्मजौ
verses.iast:
katham nu khalu duṣpāram tariṣyanti mahāudadhim |
tāni hari ṛkṣa sainyāni tau vā nara vara ātmajau
verses.translation: "'How indeed can those troops of monkeys and bears or Rama and Lakshmana can cross that great insurmountable ocean?'"

verses.devanagari:
त्रयाणाम् एव भूतानाम् सागरस्य अस्य लन्घने |
शक्तिः स्यात् वैनतेयस्य वायोः वा तव वा अनघ
verses.iast:
trayāṇām eva bhūtānām sāgarasya asya langhane |
śaktiḥ syāt vainateyasya vāyoḥ vā tava vā anagha
verses.translation: "'Three beings viz. Garuda the eagle, or yourself or the wind-god only have the capacity of crossing this ocean'."

verses.devanagari:
तत् अस्मिन् कार्य नियोगे वीर एवम् दुरतिक्रमे |
किम् पश्यसि समाधानम् ब्रूहि कार्यविदाम् वर
verses.iast:
tat asmin kārya niyoge vīra evam duratikrame |
kim paśyasi samādhānam brūhi kāryavidām vara
verses.translation: "'O valiant monkey! That is why, what strategy are you visualizing to fulfill this act, which is so difficult to accomplish thus? You are indeed excellent of those who know how to accomplish any work'."

glosses.meaning: which is so difficult to accomplish
of those who know how to accomplish any work.

verses.devanagari:
कामम् अस्य त्वम् एव एकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने ||
पर्याप्तः पर वीरघ्न यशस्यः ते बल उदयः
verses.iast:
kāmam asya tvam eva ekaḥ kāryasya parisādhane ||
paryāptaḥ para vīraghna yaśasyaḥ te bala udayaḥ
verses.translation: "O Hanuma the annihilator of hostile enemies! You, as one alone, are capable of fulfilling this task. Your act of fulfilling this task your act of fulfilling the result is well-known."

glosses.meaning: O Hanuma the annihilator of strong enemies!

verses.devanagari:
बलैः समग्रैः यदि माम् हत्वा रावणम् आहवे |
विजयी स्वाम् पुरीम् रामो नयेत् तत् स्यात् यशः करम्
verses.iast:
balaiḥ samagraiḥ yadi mām hatvā rāvaṇam āhave |
vijayī svām purīm rāmo nayet tat syāt yaśaḥ karam
verses.translation: ""It would result in his glory, if Rama, after killing Ravana along with his entire army, takes me to his city in his victory'."

verses.devanagari:
यथा अहम् तस्य वीरस्य वनात् उपधिना हृता |
रक्षसा तत् भयात् एव तथा न अर्हति राघवः
verses.iast:
yathā aham tasya vīrasya vanāt upadhinā hṛtā |
rakṣasā tat bhayāt eva tathā na arhati rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "'Rama ought not to take me back for fear that Ravana, in the same manner as Ravana the demon took me away from the forest in the absence of Rama by cheating that heroic Rama."

verses.devanagari:
बलैः तु सम्कुलाम् कृत्वा लन्काम् पर बल अर्दनः |
माम् नयेत् यदि काकुत्स्थः तत् तस्य सदृशम् भवेत्
verses.iast:
balaiḥ tu samkulām kṛtvā lankām para bala ardanaḥ |
mām nayet yadi kākutsthaḥ tat tasya sadṛśam bhavet
verses.translation: If Rama, the destroyer of rival army, fills the entire Lanka with arrows and takes me home, it will be quite worthy of him."

glosses.meaning: the destroyer of army of adversaries

verses.devanagari:
तत् यथा तस्य विक्रान्तम् अनुरूपम् महात्मनः |
भवति आहव शूरस्य तथा त्वम् उपपादय
verses.iast:
tat yathā tasya vikrāntam anurūpam mahātmanaḥ |
bhavati āhava śūrasya tathā tvam upapādaya
verses.translation: "For that reason, you act in such a way, that the high-souled Rama, valiant in battle, exhibits the prowess befitting of him."

verses.devanagari:
तत् अर्थ उपहितम् वाक्यम् प्रश्रितम् हेतु सम्हितम् |
निशम्य अहम् ततः शेषम् वाक्यम् उत्तरम् अब्रुवम्
verses.iast:
tat artha upahitam vākyam praśritam hetu samhitam |
niśamya aham tataḥ śeṣam vākyam uttaram abruvam
verses.translation: "Hearing that appeal (of Seetha), that was somewhat good in its meaning, courteous and duly furnished with reasons, I gave then my remaining reply (as follows):

glosses.meaning: that was somewhat good in fits meaning

verses.devanagari:
देवि हरि ऋक्ष सैन्यानाम् ईश्वरः प्लवताम् वरः |
सुग्रीवः सत्त्व सम्पन्नः तव अर्थे कृत निश्चयः
verses.iast:
devi hari ṛkṣa sainyānām īśvaraḥ plavatām varaḥ |
sugrīvaḥ sattva sampannaḥ tava arthe kṛta niścayaḥ
verses.translation: "'O Seetha the princess! Sugreeva, the lord of the troops of monkeys and bears, excellent among the monkeys and endowed with strength, is firmly determined to rescue you."

glosses.meaning: of the armies of monkeys and bears

verses.devanagari:
तस्य विक्रम सम्पन्नाः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः |
मनः सम्कल्प सम्पाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः
येषाम् न उपरि न अधस्तान् न तिर्यक् सज्जते गतिः |
न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्व् अमित तेजसः
verses.iast:
tasya vikrama sampannāḥ sattvavanto mahābalāḥ |
manaḥ samkalpa sampātā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ
yeṣām na upari na adhastān na tiryak sajjate gatiḥ |
na ca karmasu sīdanti mahatsv amita tejasaḥ
verses.translation: "So many monkeys, endowed with prowess, perseverance great strength and who can rush to any place as they wish, are intensely committed to Sugreeva's command. There is no hindrance to their movement either in the sky or the ground or in a horizontal region between the sky and the ground. Those monkeys with unlimited splendour are not indolent in performing any great task."

glosses.meaning: and who can rush to any place as they wish

verses.devanagari:
असकृत् तैः महाभागैः वानरैः बल सम्युतैः |
प्रदक्षिणी कृता भूमिः वायु मार्ग अनुसारिभिः
verses.iast:
asakṛt taiḥ mahābhāgaiḥ vānaraiḥ bala samyutaiḥ |
pradakṣiṇī kṛtā bhūmiḥ vāyu mārga anusāribhiḥ
verses.translation: "Those illustrious monkeys, proud of their strength and following the path of wind, circumambulated the entire earth several times."

glosses.meaning: and who follow the path of wind

verses.devanagari:
मत् विशिष्टाः च तुल्याः च सन्ति तत्र वन ओकसः |
मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन् न अस्ति सुग्रीव सम्निधौ
अहम् तावत् इह प्राप्तः किम् पुनः ते महाबलाः |
न हि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हि इतरे जनाः
verses.iast:
mat viśiṣṭāḥ ca tulyāḥ ca santi tatra vana okasaḥ |
mattaḥ pratyavaraḥ kaścin na asti sugrīva samnidhau
aham tāvat iha prāptaḥ kim punaḥ te mahābalāḥ |
na hi prakṛṣṭāḥ preṣyante preṣyante hi itare janāḥ
verses.translation: "'In them, some of the monkeys are superior to me and some are even equal to me. No one in the vicinity of Sugreeva is inferior to me. When I have arrived here, why to talk about those mighty ones? Generally, superior ones are not sent for errands. Only others are indeed sent'."

glosses.meaning: and some even equal to me

verses.devanagari:
तत् अलम् परितापेन देवि मन्युः व्यपैतु ते |
एक उत्पातेन ते लन्काम् एष्यन्ति हरि यूथपाः
verses.iast:
tat alam paritāpena devi manyuḥ vyapaitu te |
eka utpātena te lankām eṣyanti hari yūthapāḥ
verses.translation: "'O Seetha the princess! Enough of your lamentation. Take away your sorrow. Those leaders of monkeys will reach Lanka by one single leap'."

verses.devanagari:
मम पृष्ठ गतौ तौ च चन्द्र सूर्याव् इव उदितौ |
त्वत् सकाशम् महाभागे नृ सिम्हाव् आगमिष्यतः
verses.iast:
mama pṛṣṭha gatau tau ca candra sūryāv iva uditau |
tvat sakāśam mahābhāge nṛ simhāv āgamiṣyataḥ
verses.translation: "Rama and Lakshmana, those two lions among men, also of great strength, ascending on my shoulders, can come to you, like the rising sun and the moon."

glosses.meaning: like the rising sun and the moon.

verses.devanagari:
अरिघ्नम् सिम्ह सम्काशम् क्षिप्रम् द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् |
लक्ष्मणम् च धनुष् पाणिम् लन्का द्वारम् उपस्थितम्
verses.iast:
arighnam simha samkāśam kṣipram drakṣyasi rāghavam |
lakṣmaṇam ca dhanuṣ pāṇim lankā dvāram upasthitam
verses.translation: "Rama, the annihilator of enemies, similar to a lion, and Lakshmana wielding a bow in his hand, will surely approach the entrance-gate of Lanka and you will see them soon."

glosses.meaning: wielding or bow in his hand

verses.devanagari:
नख दम्ष्ट्र आयुधान् वीरान् सिम्ह शार्दूल विक्रमान् |
वानरान् वानर इन्द्र आभान् क्षिप्रम् द्रक्ष्यसि सम्गतान्
verses.iast:
nakha damṣṭra āyudhān vīrān simha śārdūla vikramān |
vānarān vānara indra ābhān kṣipram drakṣyasi samgatān
verses.translation: "'You can see soon those valiant monkeys, with their claws and tusks as weapons, having the prowess of lions and tigers and looking like lordly elephants, coming here together'."

glosses.meaning: with their claws and tusks as weapons
having the prowess of lions and tigers

verses.devanagari:
शैल अम्बुदन् निकाशानाम् लन्का मलय सानुषु |
नर्दताम् कपि मुख्यानाम् अचिरात् शोष्यसे स्वनम्
verses.iast:
śaila ambudan nikāśānām lankā malaya sānuṣu |
nardatām kapi mukhyānām acirāt śoṣyase svanam
verses.translation: "'You will hear within a short time, the clamour of the excellent of monkeys resonating like a mountains and clouds, on the peaks of Mount Malaya in Lanka'."

glosses.meaning: on the mountain-peaks of Mount Malayaa in Lanka

verses.devanagari:
निवृत्त वन वासम् च त्वया सार्धम् अरिम् दमम् |
अभिषिक्तम् अयोध्यायाम् क्षिप्रम् द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्
verses.iast:
nivṛtta vana vāsam ca tvayā sārdham arim damam |
abhiṣiktam ayodhyāyām kṣipram drakṣyasi rāghavam
verses.translation: "'You will see Rama, the annihilator of enemies, returning from exile, and getting anointed to the crown in Ayodhya, along with you soon'."

verses.devanagari:
ततो मया वाग्भिः अदीन भाषिणी |
शिवाभिः इष्टाभिः अभिप्रसादिता |
जगाम शान्तिम् मम मैथिल आत्मजा |
तव अपि शोकेन तथा अभिपीडिता
verses.iast:
tato mayā vāgbhiḥ adīna bhāṣiṇī |
śivābhiḥ iṣṭābhiḥ abhiprasāditā |
jagāma śāntim mama maithila ātmajā |
tava api śokena tathā abhipīḍitā
verses.translation: "Thereafter, soothened by me with comforting, well-disposed and agreeable words, Seetha, though tormented with thought of your grief, obtained peace of mind."

glosses.meaning: though tormented with thought of your sorrow too
